releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.4.12 (Build 89):
• Royal Burgundy Single-Hue Theme: Fixed pink washout across M3 tones and set Royal Burgundy (#8B1E3F → #B52B4D) with subtle gradient depth across every interface, card, and pop-up while preserving iOS Liquid Blue as a preset.
• Unified Theme Icons & Controls: Replaced stray blue, green, amber, and purple hardcoded icons, spinners, badges, AI logos, and custom interactive vectors across every interface and modal with active theme tokens.
• What's New & Updater Visual Refresh: Replaced Gemini-style star glyphs in What's New updates and the In-App Updater modal with interface-matched Phosphor icons.
• Pure iOS Water Liquid Glass Refinement: Preserved borderless meniscus water refraction, dock droplet glass sheen, and crisp white legibility on obsidian surfaces.
